CarrierKind.description:
The kind of a carrier (doc 03 §16). Format 0.1 types rails and ducts; busbar systems and the surface itself are
kept verbatim as [`CarrierKind::Unknown`].

CarrierParams.description: The parameters of a carrier (doc 12 §2.4), tagged by the kind: `{"rail": {…}}` or `{"duct": {…}}`.

DuctParams.description: A duct's parameters (doc 12 §2.4): the nominal size, from which the label "W×H" ("40×60") is generated.

cover.description: Whether the duct has its cover; absent: not recorded.

height.description: The height out of the plate.

slot_pitch.description: The slot pitch; absent: from the part.

Ident.description: An identifier: non-empty, one line (no control character U+0000 to U+001F or U+007F to U+009F), without leading or trailing white space (the Unicode White_Space set); interior spaces are allowed (doc 05 §3.2). JSON Schema cannot express Unicode Normalization Form C; the reader rejects non-NFC text.

MountKind.description: How a part mounts (doc 12 §2.5); also the profile of a rail section.

Nm.description: A length in nanometres (doc 05 §3.2). Written without fraction or exponent; JSON Schema cannot tell 5 from 5.0, the reader rejects the latter.

PartRef.description: A part on a device (doc 03 §7): the embedded copy and an optional part variant (FR-PRT-003).

copy.description: The copy ID of the embedded part, `v5(NS_LIBCOPY, library ‖ item)`.

variant.description: A variant key of the part.

profile.description: The rail profile (TS 35×7.5); the mount kinds that fit it are a table in `ew-derive` (doc 12 §3.3).

SurfacePt2.description: A point [u, v] in nanometres in the frame of a mounting surface, u to the right, v up (doc 03 §16): not a sheet point.

description:
A carrier on a mounting surface (doc 03 §16, rank 53, the layout file of its surface's space): a DIN rail or a
wiring duct. Its placements' poses are relative to it, so moving a rail moves its devices.

At the MVP carriers are axis-parallel (WP-S4.01 D5): a rail's `path` is two points on one horizontal or vertical
line, a duct's an orthogonal polyline; the commands refuse other angles.

$k.description: The kind name; always the first member.

part.description: The layout-only part, counted in the BOM by length (FR-LAY-008); its copy cannot be deleted while used.

path.description: The path in the surface frame: a rail's start and end, a duct's centreline vertices.

pe_bond.description: Whether the carrier is bonded to PE (FR-LAY-058).

surface.description:
The mounting surface (delete policy cascade; changing it moves the carrier and its placements to that
surface's layout file).
